entry.title: New: Resolution 203 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
ADOPTS THE 2023 INTEGRATED CLIMATE ACTION PLAN AS THE COUNTY’S OFFICIAL STRATEGIC PLAN TO ACHIEVE ITS EMISSIONS MITIGATION AND CLIMATE ADAPTATION GOALS AND TARGETS

Seeks to mitigate the County’s greenhouse gas emissions and reinforce County assets, services, and infrastructure to adapt to the impacts and hazards of climate change.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 203-23 & PCCRRA-1 - 08/02/23
